data.gender_notes: Qasidaht is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A poetic composition consisting of a sequence of rhyming lines, often with a musical accompaniment. A form of literary and artistic expression in Arabic culture. The name Qasidaht carries the meaning “Poem, Composition, Sequence” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Qasidaht usually hope their child will grow to embody poem, composition, sequence and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qasidaht total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
